instructions:
Containment Protocol — client-side React/TypeScript SPA. Pure simulation in src/domain/; Zustand store in src/app/store/; projections in src/features/*View.ts; UI in src/features/**/*.tsx. Linear is system of record; PRs implement one slice with acceptance from planning/spe-*-slice.md.

READ FIRST: PR body Linear section (SPE-#### slice issue), stated scope boundary, and AGENTS.md Review guidelines.

SEVERITY — P0/P1: correctness, determinism, hydration, layer boundaries, week-close ordering, hidden UI truth, event migrations, missing required tests, security. Do NOT flag style nits, drive-by refactors, scope expansion, or pre-existing npm run build TS drift unless this PR worsens it.

ARCHITECTURE — domain pure (no React/store/features); store orchestration only; *View.ts projections pure; UI presentational. Vite 8: import type for type-only imports in dev-server-loaded files.

SCOPE — match Linear/slice acceptance; smallest in-boundary fix suggestions only.

rules.rule: src/domain must stay pure: no React, store, or features imports; flag non-determinism and silent state mutation.
Week-close ordering in src/domain/sim is P0: operating cost, procurement, registry hooks, funding must run at correct phase; no double-run on replay.
Event schema changes require migration per SCHEMA_REGISTRY.md and validation in eventValidation.ts.
*View.ts files are pure projections: no side effects, no cross-feature imports, do not re-derive canonical domain summaries.
React components use projections; flag deep domain imports and simulation logic in .tsx files.
Vitest tests must be deterministic; flag missing coverage for persistence/user-visible behavior and weakened assertions.
PR must not exceed planning/spe-*-slice.md Goal/Acceptance or contradict ## Deferred.
New docs/*audit*.md requires docs/design-audits-index.md update in strict alphabetical order.
Do not weaken CI: Node 22, STRICT_TEST_CONSOLE=1, or skip tests.
